description: Update a discount (partial). code/type/currency become immutable once the discount has been used. A code with any minimum (minSubtotal for the default currency, minSubtotalByCurrency for additional currencies) applies only in the currencies those minimums name.

idOrSlug.description: The discount's id or code to update

minSubtotal.description: Minimum subtotal in minor units: the code's own currency for 'fixed', the default currency otherwise. null clears it - with minSubtotalByCurrency set, the code then no longer applies to default-currency carts

minSubtotalByCurrency.description: 'percentage' and 'free_shipping' only: replaces the per-currency minimums for carts in additional currencies; [] clears them. Omit to keep them. Changing such a code to 'fixed' needs [] here

currency.description: One of the workspace's additional currencies (update_cart_config additionalCurrencies)

name: update_discount
title: Update discount
